entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you provide your order number? And just to be sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it more of a preference issue?
VF098765. It's a jersey. It's just the wrong size. Not much of a preference when it doesn't fit.
I see. Thank you for clarifying. So the issue is that the jersey you received is too tight, is that correct?

Understood. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Jersey, delivered 55 days ago. I also see you're one of our VIP members, so thank you for your loyalty.
Well, you're well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel. We can definitely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
I guess an exchange is fine. If you can get the size right this time.

Absolutely. I can process that exchange for you right away. And for the inconvenience of receiving the wrong size, I've gone ahead and upgraded the shipping on your new jersey to complimentary overnight express. I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase.
Whatever. Just send me the return label.

Of course. I've just processed the exchange for the next size up and sent the prepaid return label to the email on file. You should see it within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
